lore.minecraft.rabbit_hide: An item that can be crafted into Leather. Dropped by Rabbits, Wolves, Foxes, and Bears.
tag.c.waxed.description: A block that has since been waxed with Beeswax to prevent it from aging. It can be scraped off with an Axe.
lore.minecraft.honeycomb: Wax harvested from beehives with Shears. Used to wax Copper, treat wood, and make Candles.
lore.spicedcider.tallow: Animal fat rendered in a Cooking Pot. Used for frying, soap, and Candles.
lore.minecraft.sulfur_cube_bucket: A bucket with a Living Bubble inside.
lore.minecraft.ancient_debris: A block that can be smelted into Ancient Scrap.
lore.minecraft.netherite_scrap: A metal piece that can be combined with gold to make an Infernite Ingot.
lore.minecraft.netherite_upgrade_smithin: A template that can be used in a Smithing Table to upgrade Diamond gear to Infernite. It's an uncommon find.
tag.c.ores.netherite_scrap.description: A block that can be smelted into Ancient Scrap.
